description: The "Body of Knowledge" sculpture by Jaume Plensa at Goethe University in Frankfurt, Germany (© Todamo/Shutterstock)

A chrysanthemum emerges from the darkness in The Indestructible, a series by photographers Angel Albarrán and Anna P. Cabrera, who work together as Albarrán Cabrera. For this image, they applied a cyanotype emulsion over a carbon print, creating an irregular, textured surface that gives the photograph an almost three-dimensional quality. The technique reinforces an idea central to their work: A photograph is not only an image, but a physical object shaped by light, chemistry, and materials.
